data.Name: Ahsoka Tano
data.Subtitle: Chasing Whispers
data.FrontText: When Played: An opponent discards a card from their hand. If it's a unit, you may exhaust a unit.

data.Name: Count Dooku
data.Subtitle: Fallen Jedi
data.FrontText:
Exploit 2 
Overwhelm 
When Played: For each unit you exploited while playing this card, you may deal damage to an enemy unit equal to the power of the exploited unit.

data.Name: Darth Maul
data.Subtitle: Revenge At Last
data.FrontText: This unit can attack 2 units instead of 1. (This unit deals its combat damage to both defenders and they both deal their combat damage to this unit. All damage is dealt simultaneously.)

data.Name: Darth Sion
data.Subtitle: Lord of Pain
data.FrontText:
When Played: Give an Experience token to this unit for each enemy unit that was defeated this phase.
When Defeated: If this unit had 7 or more power, return him to his owner's hand.

data.Name: Darth Vader
data.Subtitle: Scourge of Squadrons
data.FrontText:
Piloting [C=3 Aggression Villainy]
Attached unit gains: "On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a unit. If a unit is defeated this way, you may deal 1 damage to a unit or base."

data.Name: Enfys Nest
data.Subtitle: Champion of Justice
data.FrontText:
Saboteur 
When Played/On Attack: You may return an enemy non-leader unit with less power than this unit to its owner's hand.

data.Name: General Grievous
data.Subtitle: Scuttling to Safety
data.FrontText:
Hidden (This unit can't be attacked if he was played this phase.)
When this unit is attacked: Return him to his owner's hand (before damage is dealt).

data.Name: HK-47
data.Subtitle: Exclamation: Die, Meatbag!
data.FrontText: When an enemy unit is defeated: Deal 1 damage to its controller's base.

data.Name: Karis Nemik
data.Subtitle: Freedom is a Pure Idea
data.FrontText:
Hidden
When Defeated: You may disclose Aggression Heroism (reveal cards from your hand with these aspect icons among them). If you do, create a Spy token and ready it.

data.Name: Ki-Adi-Mundi
data.Subtitle: Composed and Confident
data.FrontText: Coordinate - When an opponent plays their second card each phase: You may draw 2 cards.

data.Name: Luke Skywalker
data.Subtitle: A Hero's Beginning
data.FrontText: When you play another unique unit: You may use the Force (lose your Force token). If you do, give an Experience token and a Shield token to this unit.

data.Name: Luke Skywalker
data.Subtitle: You Still With Me?
data.FrontText:
Piloting [C=3 Command Heroism] (You may play this as an upgrade on a friendly vehicle without a pilot.) 
if this upgrade would be defeated, you may instead move him to the ground arena as a unit and exhaust him.

data.Name: Oggdo Bogdo
data.Subtitle: Bogano Brute
data.FrontText:
This unit can't attack unless it's damaged. 
When this unit attacks and defeats a unit: Heal 2 damage from this unit.

data.Name: Poggle the Lesser
data.Subtitle: Archduke of the Stalgasin Hive
data.FrontText: When you play another unit: You may exhaust this unit. If you do, create a Battle Droid token.

data.Name: Queen Amidala
data.Subtitle: Championing Her People
data.FrontText:
When Played: Create 2 Spy tokens.
If damage would be dealt to this unit, you may defeat another friendly unit that shares a trait with this unit. If you do, prevent that damage.

data.Name: Rey
data.Subtitle: With Palpatine's Power
data.FrontText: When you draw this card during the action phase: If you control a Aggression leader or base, you may reveal this card from your hand. If you do, deal 2 damage to a unit and 2 damage to a base.

data.Name: The Ghost
data.Subtitle: Heart of the Family
data.FrontText:
Each other friendly Spectre unit gains this unit's Keywords. 
While this unit is upgraded, it gains Sentinel.

data.Name: The Mandalorian
data.Subtitle: Cleaning Up Nevarro
data.FrontText:
Ambush
When this unit attacks and defeats a unit: You may choose an enemy non-leader unit. This unit captures it.

data.Name: Yoda
data.Subtitle: My Ally is the Force
data.FrontText:
When Played: You may use the Force. If you do, heal 5 damage from a base.
When you use the Force: You may deal damage to a unit equal to twice the number of units you control.
